messages:
Maya (CS): Heads up — Palisade Analytics showing a 63% drop in token usage this week vs last. Champion left, procurement flagged a budget freeze, and they've kicked off a competitor pilot with SparkLayer. Renewal is ~6 weeks out. Who can own a rescue play?
Noah - Solutions: I can join. Do we have the most recent eval set and which endpoints are impacted?
Maya (CS): Top-3 impacted: inference endpoint 'report-summarize' (~70% of calls), the nightly batch embed job, and the internal QA harness. Usage query I ran: 
```sql
SELECT endpoint, count(*) FROM logs WHERE customer_id='palisade' AND ts > '2026-03-01' GROUP BY endpoint;
```
Summary: report-summarize down ~72%.
Priya - AE: @Maya looped in procurement contact — they confirmed budget hold pending Q2 forecast. Sales has a contact on the SparkLayer POC and shared screenshots. I can prepare concession ranges if we coordinate.
Sam - CSM Lead: Let's schedule a rescue sync in the next 48h. Priorities: 1) Ops quick-win (restore batch cadence) 2) Exec briefing with interim CTO 3) Competitive displacement plan. @Noah can you prepare a short perf/cost delta vs SparkLayer?
Ava - PM: We shipped a latency-fix last week; could be increasing retries and lowering effective calls. Can eng-runtime check error/retry rates and flag history? I can pull feature flag toggles.
InsightBot: Alert: anomaly detected for customer palisade — token delta -63% (alert id: A-9876). Suggested run: customer_health.report('palisade').
Maya (CS): Created calendar invite for rescue sync (tomorrow 11:00 PT). Pre-call action items: @Noah one-slide perf/cost delta, @Priya procurement levers + payment deferral ask, @Ava deploy/flag timeline, @Sam executive briefing template. Proposing a 3-week courtesy credit + 2-week pilot extension as a starting concession.
Noah - Solutions: On it. Quick note: SparkLayer shows ~1.8x throughput in their bench but lacks prefix caching; cost parity will depend on batch sizes. I'll include latency numbers and a short mitigation plan (prefix caching + small-batch ops).
Priya - AE: I'll draft a one-pager with concession ranges and an exec-level script for the call. Can we offer a dedicated support window during their pilot? That helps with friction.
Maya (CS): :thumbsup: I'll draft the customer-facing email and share before 10:30 PT for review.
Sam - CSM Lead: Flagging renewal_health -> YELLOW. Assign playbook: 'competitive_rescue_v2'. @Maya please log play and notes in Gainsight.
Maya (CS): Logged in Gainsight. Quick intel — original champion Lena Mora left; interim CTO is Marcus Hui (joined 3 days ago), background in infra (Cloudcrest). Might push toward self-hosted or infra-heavy solutions.
Ava - PM: Noted. I'll log potential product asks (on-prem connectors) under Palisade tag but mark low priority for roadmap.
InsightBot: Invite status: Marcus_Hui@palisade.com accepted the calendar invite.
Priya - AE: Customer asked whether we can pause the upcoming invoice until pilot completes. Legal ok with short deferral if we formalize SLA and deliverables.
Maya (CS): Plan of record: 1) Rescue sync -> 2) Send exec deck + concession offer -> 3) Run joint pilot (dedicated support) -> 4) QBR in 4 weeks and reassess renewal. Any objections?
Noah - Solutions: No objections. I'll drop draft slides in this thread by 9:30 PT.
Maya (CS): Thanks — using this thread as single source for pre-call artifacts. /cc @Sam
